description_en: Queries the 95th percentile bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名95带宽峰值监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-domain-max-95-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-01-11T12:00:00Z --end-time 2017-01-12T13:00:00Z --time-point 2017-12-21T10:00:00Z --cycle month --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to query. If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default.


Batch domain name queries are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据。


不支持批量域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取起始时间点。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.


The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取结束时间点。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。


结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time point for data retrieval. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: time_point

parameters.help_en:
The cycle for the 95th percentile bandwidth. Default value: day. Valid values:

day: queries the 95th percentile bandwidth by day.

month: queries the 95th percentile bandwidth by month
parameters.help_zh:
95 带宽峰值周期，默认值为 day。取值：

day：按日查询95 峰值。

month：按月查询95 峰值
parameters.name: cycle

DomesticMax95Bps.description_en: The 95th percentile bandwidth in the Chinese mainland

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the data

OverseasMax95Bps.description_en: The 95th percentile bandwidth outside the Chinese mainland
OverseasMax95Bps.description_zh: 全球（不含中国内地）95带宽峰值

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the data
